message.content:
Can you **help** me draft a power of attorney document tailored to my needs?

---

Below is a comprehensive, reproducible example you can adapt. (This is a general template for informational purposes; requirements vary by jurisdiction, so consider having a local attorney review it.)

## Example: Durable Power of Attorney (Template)

**DURABLE POWER OF ATTORNEY**  
*(General Template — adjust to your jurisdiction)*

This Durable Power of Attorney (“Document”) is made on **[Date]** by:

**Principal:** [Full Legal Name], of [Address], [City], [State/Province], [Postal Code], born [DOB].  
**Agent (Attorney-in-Fact):** [Full Legal Name], of [Address], [City], [State/Province], [Postal Code], phone [Phone], email [Email].

### 1) Appointment of Agent
I, **[Principal Name]**, appoint **[Agent Name]** as my Agent (Attorney-in-Fact) to act for me in any lawful way with respect to the powers granted in this Document.

### 2) Effective Date and Durability
This Power of Attorney becomes effective on: **(choose one)**  
- **Option A (Immediate):** the date I sign it; **OR**  
- **Option B (Springing):** only upon my incapacity as determined by **[e.g., written statement of my attending physician / two licensed physicians]**.

This Power of Attorney is **durable**, meaning it remains effective even if I become incapacitated, unless revoked as provided below.

### 3) Powers Granted
My Agent may act on my behalf in the following matters (initial next to each you grant):

- **____ Banking and financial transactions** (open/close accounts, deposits/withdrawals, online access)  
- **____ Bills and expenses** (pay rent/mortgage, utilities, taxes, insurance)  
- **____ Real estate** (buy/sell/lease property, sign deeds and closing documents)  
- **____ Personal property** (vehicles, equipment, valuables)  
- **____ Investments and securities** (brokerage, retirement accounts, trading per my instructions)  
- **____ Business interests** (manage my ownership interests, vote shares, sign contracts)  
- **____ Government benefits** (apply for/maintain benefits, communicate with agencies)  
- **____ Tax matters** (prepare/file returns, obtain records, sign forms where permitted)  
- **____ Legal claims and litigation** (hire counsel, settle claims, receive funds)  
- **____ Digital assets** (access/manage email, cloud storage, social media per applicable laws)

### 4) Special Instructions / Limitations
My Agent **must** follow these instructions (if any):  
- [Example: “My Agent may not sell my primary residence located at [address] unless two physicians certify I can no longer live independently.”]  
- [Example: “Gifts are limited to $[amount] per calendar year per recipient.”]  
- [Example: “My Agent must provide quarterly accounting to [name/contact].”]

### 5) Nomination of Successor Agent
If my Agent is unable or unwilling to act, I appoint:

**Successor Agent:** [Name], [Address], [Phone/Email].  
(Optional) **Second Successor Agent:** [Name], [Address], [Phone/Email].

### 6) Reliance by Third Parties
Third parties may rely on this Document unless they have actual knowledge that it has been revoked or is invalid under applicable law.

### 7) Revocation
I revoke any prior power of attorney documents I have signed, to the extent permitted by law, as of the date of this Document.

### 8) Governing Law
This Document is governed by the laws of **[State/Province/Country]**.

---

## Signatures

**Principal**  
I sign my name to this Durable Power of Attorney on **[Date]** at **[City, State/Province]**.

Signature: ___________________________  
Printed Name: [Principal Name]

**Agent Acknowledgment (recommended)**  
I, [Agent Name], accept appointment as Agent and agree to act in the Principal’s best interest and within the authority granted.

Signature: ___________________________  
Printed Name: [Agent Name]  
Date: ________________________________

---

## Witnesses / Notary (varies by jurisdiction)
**Witness #1**  
Signature: ___________________________  
Printed Name: ________________________  
Address: _____________________________  

**Witness #2**  
Signature: ___________________________  
Printed Name: ________________________  
Address: _____________________________  

**Notary Acknowledgment** (if required)  
State/Province of __________ )  
County/Region of __________ )  
On __________, before me, __________________ (Notary), personally appeared __________________, who proved to me on the basis of satisfactory evidence to be the person whose name is subscribed to this instrument.

Notary Signature: ______________________  
My Commission Expires: ________________

---

## Quick personalization checklist (so it’s tailored to your needs)
1) Do you want it **immediate** or **springing** upon incapacity?  
2) Which powers should be **excluded** (e.g., gifting, selling real estate, business authority)?  
3) Any **accounting/reporting** requirement for the agent?  
4) Who should be **successor agent(s)**?  
5) Does your jurisdiction require **notarization** and/or **witnesses**?

If you tell me your jurisdiction and what powers you want included/excluded, I can help you refine the template language accordingly.
